implementation.authority: The material consumes cooked depth, speed, and foam presentation channels. It cannot change solver state, surface topology, wetness, bathymetry, collision, buoyancy, rapid forcing, or raft forces.

visual_comparison.method: Direct sRGB metrics over matched 1280x720 breaking_water_side gameplay captures. Water metrics use rows 260 through 719; far-band metrics use rows 220 through 339. Luminance is Rec.709-weighted sRGB.
visual_comparison.verdict: Retain bracket C. Futaleufu mean falls 2.56 percent, right clear-water mean falls 5.65 percent, and body contrast rises 19.11 percent; the increased upper-tail fraction remains localized to preserved solver whitewater and direct-lit breaking faces. Chilko mean falls 21.40 percent, p95 falls 4.52 percent, far-band mean falls 14.33 percent, and contrast rises 37.33 percent. Both rivers now separate clear depth from aeration more strongly without hiding solver foam or turning the body opaque.
